name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: "Classic Margherita Pizza on a wooden board, topped with tomato sauce, melted cheese, and fresh basil leaves. The crust is charred and slightly puffed. The pizza is cut into four slices, with one slice partially pulled away. Served with a side of tomato sauce and olive oil."

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: Chicken Tikka Masala served in a bronze bowl with handles, garnished with parsley, accompanied by basmati rice and naan bread on a wooden table.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: "A bowl of stir-fried vegetables and tofu, featuring broccoli, carrots, snap peas, and cubed tofu in a savory brown sauce, served with a side of white rice and accompanied by chopsticks."

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: Greek salad in a white bowl, featuring lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, feta cheese, and Kalamata olives, presented on a wooden table with a dressing in a small glass jar and a lemon wedge.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio served in a white bowl, topped with grated cheese, parsley, and garlic, on a wooden table with a fork and chili flakes nearby.

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: Glazed salmon fillet on a wooden cutting board, garnished with dill and spices, accompanied by a fork and lemon wedges, with a glass of glaze in the background.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.
image_description: "Tomato Basil Soup served in a blue-rimmed bowl, garnished with fresh basil leaves and herbs, surrounded by ingredients like tomatoes, garlic, chili peppers, olive oil, salt, and basil on a light gray surface."

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.
image_description: Pad Thai with shrimp, bean sprouts, green onions, and cashews, garnished with a lime wedge and served on a brown plate, surrounded by ingredients like garlic, chili flakes, and spices.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini, featuring crispy fried falafel patties on a plate with sliced red onions, lemon, garlic, and parsley, surrounded by bowls of chickpeas, tahini sauce, and spices, with a recipe displayed in the background.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: "Four tacos on a plate, filled with seasoned ground beef, lettuce, cheese, diced tomatoes, guacamole, and sour cream, surrounded by bowls of salsa, shredded cheese, and sour cream, with lime wedges and a green pepper on the side."

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: Pan-seared ribeye steak served in a cast-iron skillet with butter and thyme, surrounded by seasonings and spices.

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: Lentil dal in a bowl, garnished with cilantro, onion, tomato, and lime, served with a spoon on a cloth napkin, surrounded by turmeric powder, fresh cilantro, onion, and garlic.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: Miso-glazed cod served on a bed of sesame rice, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds, in a ceramic bowl with a brown sauce. The dish is accompanied by a small bowl of soy sauce, a bowl of sesame seeds, and a bowl of white rice, with chopsticks and a wooden spoon on the side.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.
image_description: "Grilled chicken legs with a glossy glaze, garnished with rosemary, garlic, and lime slices, served on a wooden platter with rice, beans, and spices."

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: Penne pasta topped with roasted cherry tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and grated Parmesan cheese, served on a ceramic plate with a rustic brown rim and blue interior, surrounded by ingredients like cherry tomatoes on the vine, garlic, salt, and olive oil.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: "Paneer Butter Masala in a blue bowl, garnished with onions and herbs, served with naan bread and basmati rice, surrounded by spices and garnishes."

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: Falooda dessert drink served in tall glasses with layered ingredients including red jelly, white milk, and vermicelli noodles, topped with whipped cream, cherries, and edible flowers. The glasses are garnished with decorative spoons and surrounded by bowls of toppings and loose rose petals on a gray slate platter.

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: Shakshuka in a black skillet, featuring eggs poached in a vibrant mixture of red and green peppers, onions, and tomatoes. The dish is surrounded by various ingredients and spices, including chili peppers, garlic, parsley, and small bowls of seasonings. The skillet is presented on a gray surface, showcasing a colorful and appetizing meal.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: Cuban Black Beans and Rice served on a white plate, featuring a mound of white rice surrounded by dark brown beans, sliced garlic, and green leaves.

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: "Sliced beef, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds, served on a bed of onions in a shallow bowl. The dish is surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings, including rice, garlic, and spices."

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: Chicken paella served in a large pan with yellow rice, chicken legs, tomatoes, onions, and red peppers, garnished with rosemary, on a wooden table surrounded by ingredients and cooking utensils.

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.
image_description: "Tom Yum Goong soup in a white bowl, featuring shrimp, mushrooms, lemongrass, lime, chili peppers, and cilantro in a spicy broth, served with a spoon and accompanied by a small bowl of chili flakes on a wooden table."

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: "Grilled chicken Caesar salad with romaine lettuce, croutons, cherry tomatoes, shaved parmesan cheese, and creamy dressing, presented in a dark bowl with a mix of textures and colors."

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: "Baked Moussaka in a metal pan, featuring layered eggplant slices, ground meat, and melted cheese, garnished with fresh herbs, surrounded by ingredients and spices on a wooden table."

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: "Shoyu Ramen with sliced chicken, boiled egg, green onions, and sesame seeds in a savory broth, served in a black bowl."

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: "Shrimp pasta dish with fettuccine noodles, cooked shrimp, green beans, and lemon slices, seasoned with herbs and spices, served on a ceramic plate surrounded by ingredients like lemons, garlic, salt, and pepper."

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: "Vibrant ratatouille dish featuring sliced eggplant, zucchini, tomatoes, and red peppers, garnished with fresh herbs, presented in a white bowl on a wooden board surrounded by whole vegetables and spices."

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: Crispy skin salmon fillets garnished with dill and spices, served with a side of dill yogurt sauce and lemon wedges on a ceramic plate, presented on a rustic wooden table with a beige napkin and utensils.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: "Thai Green Curry with Vegetables and tofu, served with white rice in a ceramic bowl. The curry contains visible ingredients such as zucchini, bell peppers, snow peas, and basil leaves. The dish is presented with chopsticks and a spoon, surrounded by scattered ingredients and seasonings on a textured surface."

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: "Mango Sticky Rice served in a bowl with white rice, mango chunks, and a yellow sauce, garnished with green leaves. The dish is presented on a blue plate with additional mango pieces and a wooden spoon containing white salt. The vibrant colors and artistic presentation highlight the dessert's key ingredients."

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: Herbed quinoa salad with sliced cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, and parsley, presented in a white bowl on a gray surface, accompanied by lemon wedges, olive oil, and a fork.

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: "Beef shawarma wrap with sliced beef, tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, and lettuce, wrapped in pita bread, accompanied by various dips and toppings."

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: "Baked chicken breasts on a bed of noodles, topped with melted cheese, pesto sauce, and cherry tomatoes, served in a ceramic baking dish with a side of pesto in a wooden spoon."

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: "Baked eggplant parmesan in a rectangular baking dish, layered with red sauce, crispy breaded eggplant slices, and melted cheese, surrounded by ingredients like tomatoes, onions, cheese, and parsley on a dark surface."

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: "Moroccan Chickpea Stew served in a decorative ceramic bowl, garnished with fresh cilantro and diced tomatoes, featuring chickpeas in a rich reddish-brown broth."

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: "Crunchy Cabbage Slaw: a mix of shredded green cabbage and carrots, presented in a blue bowl with visible dressing ingredients and seasonings, showcasing a fresh and raw preparation style with a mix of textures and colors."

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: Ceviche de Pescado in a ceramic bowl, featuring raw fish marinated with sliced red chili peppers, red onions, and cilantro, garnished with a lime wedge. The dish is presented on a wooden cutting board surrounded by whole and sliced chili peppers, red onion, salt, and limes.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: "Thai Basil Chicken served with steamed rice on a decorative plate, featuring stir-fried chicken, Thai basil, and chili peppers in a savory sauce, garnished with fresh basil leaves and surrounded by scattered ingredients and seasonings."

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
image_description: A Caprese salad featuring sliced tomatoes and mozzarella cheese, garnished with basil leaves and drizzled with olive oil and balsamic glaze, presented on a white plate.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in pumpkin puree, butter, and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: "Pumpkin risotto in a pan, topped with diced pumpkin, shallots, and butter, surrounded by ingredients like whole pumpkin, shallots, salt, and broth, presented on a rustic surface with earthy tones and varied textures."

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: "Shrimp cooked in a garlic butter sauce, served in a black skillet on a wooden tray, garnished with parsley and accompanied by lemon wedges, garlic cloves, and utensils."

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita or veggies.
image_description: "Roasted Red Pepper Hummus in a dark bowl, garnished with red chili peppers, chickpeas, and oil, surrounded by ingredients like bell peppers, garlic, and pita bread."

name: Garlic Naan
directions: Mix ingredients to form dough; knead until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour; divide and roll into rounds.
Cook on hot skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush with garlic butter and serve.
image_description: "Garlic naan bread arranged on a plate with a small bowl of garlic cloves in the center, accompanied by a fork and knife. The naan is lightly browned, topped with garlic and herbs, and has a soft texture."

name: Butter Chicken
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.
Add chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in tomato sauce and garam masala; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream; season and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: Butter chicken in a blue bowl, featuring chicken, onions, and herbs in a red sauce, presented on a dark blue background with a sprinkle of salt.

name: Coconut Curry Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve hot.
image_description: "A steaming bowl of yellow lentil soup, garnished with red chili peppers, onions, and herbs, served in a brown ceramic bowl with a swirl of white cream and surrounded by various spices and ingredients, including turmeric, lentils, and lemon halves."

name: Gyro Wrap
ingredients: Gyro meat (lamb or chicken) or substitute with sliced chicken
directions: Cook gyro meat until browned.
Warm pita; fill with meat and vegetables.
Top with tzatziki.
image_description: Gyro wrap with sliced meat, tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, and tzatziki sauce, wrapped in pita bread, presented on a wooden board with fresh ingredients and spices.

name: Pollo a la Brasa (Peruvian Roast Chicken)
directions: Marinate chicken with garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 40-45 minutes until cooked.
Serve with lime wedges.
image_description: A roasted chicken, cut into eight pieces, is arranged on a clay platter, garnished with lime slices and spices, and surrounded by additional lime slices, garlic cloves, and spices in small bowls.

name: Mango Salsa Chicken
directions: Season chicken and sear in a pan.
Top with mango salsa (mango, onion, cilantro, lime juice).
Bake 10 minutes to finish cooking.
image_description: Grilled chicken breasts topped with mango salsa, served on a white plate with a brown rim. The dish features four cooked chicken breasts with visible grill marks, surrounded by a mixture of diced mango, red onion, red pepper, and cilantro. Lime wedges are placed around the plate, and the food is bathed in a yellow sauce. The plate is set against a dark background with scattered cilantro leaves.

name: Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dip
directions: Soak rice papers; fill with noodles, greens, and protein.
Roll tightly; serve with peanut dip.
image_description: Rice paper rolls with shrimp, vegetables, and tofu, served with a peanut dipping sauce, garnished with sesame seeds and mint, on a woven platter with fresh ingredients.

name: Beef Nachos
directions: Cook beef with seasoning.
Layer chips, beef, and cheese; bake until cheese melts.
Top with beans, salsa, sour cream, and jalapenos.
image_description: "Beef nachos with tortilla chips, seasoned ground beef, baked beans, melted cheese, sour cream, sliced jalapeños, and cherry tomatoes, served on a metal platter with various toppings and condiments on the side, arranged on a rustic wooden table."

name: Herbed Chicken Skewers
directions: Thread chicken onto skewers after marinating briefly.
Grill until cooked through, basting with oil and herbs.
Serve with lemon wedges.
image_description: Grilled chicken skewers with rosemary and onions, served on a gray plate with lemon wedges and coarse salt, presented on a gray surface with scattered seasonings.

name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add coconut milk and vegetables; simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook until pink and serve.
image_description: Coconut Shrimp Curry in a pan, featuring shrimp, onions, peppers, and green chilies in a yellow curry sauce, surrounded by ingredients like coconut milk, spices, and seasonings, presented in a visually appealing and detailed illustration.

name: Herbed Mushroom Risotto
directions: Sauté onion and mushrooms; add rice and toast.
Deglaze with wine; add broth gradually until creamy.
image_description: Herbed Mushroom Risotto in a brown ceramic bowl, garnished with fresh herbs and sautéed mushrooms, surrounded by ingredients like parmesan cheese, olive oil, and raw mushrooms, on a gray-blue surface.

name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
directions: Mix all ingredients into a smooth batter.
Cook on a hot skillet until bubbles form; flip and cook through.
image_description: Lemon ricotta pancakes with powdered sugar, lemon, and butter, surrounded by ingredients including flour, butter, lemon zest, and milk, presented on a silver platter with various bowls and a spoon.

name: Egg Fried Rice
directions: Scramble eggs in a wok; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, add rice, then eggs.
Season with soy sauce and scallions.
image_description: Egg fried rice with vegetables and four fried eggs, served in a skillet. The dish is garnished with green onions and sesame seeds, and accompanied by soy sauce. The vibrant colors and textures create a visually appealing presentation.

name: Okonomiyaki (Japanese Pancake)
directions: Mix batter with cabbage.
Cook on a griddle; top with meat and flip.
Brush with sauce and drizzle with mayo.
image_description: Okonomiyaki, a Japanese savory pancake, is presented on a round, off-white plate. The pancake is topped with shredded lettuce, shrimp, and drizzled with mayonnaise and a dark sauce. A sprinkle of green seasoning is visible around the pancake. The dish is placed on a wooden table, accompanied by small bowls containing additional sauce and mayonnaise.

name: Herb-Ceta Pasta with Lemon
directions: Cook pasta; reserve some pasta water.
Toss with lemon zest, juice, herbs, and olive oil.
Add a splash of pasta water; finish with parmesan.
image_description: Penne pasta tossed in a green herb sauce, topped with grated cheese, basil leaves, and lemon wedges, served in a gray bowl on a wooden board with a fork.

name: Coconut Rice with Beans
directions: Simmer coconut milk with garlic powder; stir in beans and cilantro.
Serve over rice.
image_description: Coconut rice with beans in a large silver bowl, surrounded by various ingredients including rice, beans, coconut milk, oil, spices, garlic, and herbs, arranged on a gray surface.

name: Baked Cod with Tomato and Olive
directions: Place cod in baking dish; top with tomatoes, olives, and garlic.
Drizzle with olive oil; bake at 200°C (400°F) for 12-15 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.
image_description: Baked cod served on a plate with tomatoes, olives, and garlic, garnished with parsley and herbs, in a savory sauce.

name: Seared Tuna Niçoise
directions: Sear tuna to desired doneness.
Boil beans and potatoes; assemble with eggs and olives.
Dress with lemon vinaigrette.
image_description: Seared tuna served with green beans, potatoes, olives, and boiled egg, garnished with lemon and herbs, on a plate with a fork and knife on either side, accompanied by small bowls of olives and peas.

name: Harissa Chickpea Bowl
directions: Roast chickpeas with harissa 15-20 minutes.
Serve over quinoa with fresh vegetables and lemon yogurt sauce.
image_description: "Harissa chickpea bowl with couscous, sliced cucumbers, tomatoes, and yogurt sauce, garnished with green onions and herbs, served in a decorative bowl."

name: Salmon with Dill and Mustard Glaze
directions: Mix glaze with mustard, dill, and honey.
Brush on salmon; bake or pan-sear until flaky.
image_description: Two grilled salmon fillets topped with a glaze, fresh dill, and spices, served on a dark baking sheet with scattered salt and oil.

name: Butter Lettuce Salad with Avocado
directions: Toss greens with avocado and tomatoes.
Drizzle with vinaigrette and serve.
image_description: "Fresh salad with butter lettuce, diced avocado, and halved cherry tomatoes, served in a white bowl with a fork. A hand is pouring yellow dressing from a small pitcher. The dish is garnished with red pepper flakes and presented on a brown surface with additional ingredients."

name: Eggplant Caponata
directions: Sauté eggplant until soft.
Add vegetables and simmer with vinegar and sugar until thick.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
image_description: "Eggplant caponata in a ceramic bowl, featuring eggplant, tomatoes, celery, green olives, and capers, with a wooden spoon on the side, presented on a dark surface with a beige napkin and garnished with parsley and halved cherry tomatoes."

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
directions: Toast bread; mash avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Poach eggs; place on toast and serve.
image_description: "Avocado toast with poached eggs, seasoned with salt, pepper, and herbs, served on toasted bread with sliced avocado and lemon wedges on the side, accompanied by olive oil."

name: Herbed Tomato Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add tomatoes and broth.
Simmer 20 minutes; blend until smooth.
Stir in cream and herbs; season and serve.
image_description: Herbed tomato soup served in a black bowl, garnished with sliced tomatoes, basil, thyme, and cream. The soup is surrounded by ingredients, including tomatoes, garlic, onion, herbs, and spices, on a gray-blue surface.

name: Pesto Gnocchi with Cherry Tomatoes
directions: Boil gnocchi until floating; drain.
Toss with pesto and halved tomatoes; top with parmesan.
image_description: Gnocchi tossed in vibrant green pesto sauce, topped with halved cherry tomatoes and grated Parmesan cheese, garnished with fresh basil leaves on a white plate with a brown rim.

name: Paneer Butter Fry
directions: Sauté onion in butter; add paneer and brown.
Add tomato paste and spices; simmer with a splash of cream.
image_description: Paneer Butter Masala in a dark brown bowl, featuring golden-brown paneer cubes, onions, and tomatoes in a rich red sauce, topped with a dollop of white cream and spices, garnished with green herbs.

name: Lemon Garlic Roasted Brussels Sprouts
directions: Toss sprouts with oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 20-25 minutes; finish with lemon zest.
image_description: Roasted Brussels sprouts with lemon slices and garlic cloves in a brown bowl, garnished with salt and spices, showcasing a mix of green and caramelized vegetables.

name: Paneer Tarsi with Spinach
directions: Sauté onion and tomato; add spices.
Stir in spinach until wilted; add paneer and simmer briefly.
image_description: "Paneer Tarsi with Spinach, a vibrant dish featuring paneer cubes, spinach, onions, and cherry tomatoes, cooked in a pan and surrounded by various ingredients, including spices, herbs, and seasonings, presented in a colorful and appetizing manner."

name: Rendang Beef
directions: Simmer beef with coconut milk and rendang paste with aromatics until tender and thickened.
image_description: Rendang beef in a clay pot, surrounded by ingredients, on a wooden table. The dish features tender beef in a rich, dark orange sauce, garnished with green leaves. Visible ingredients include shallots, ginger, lemongrass, spices, and salt. The presentation showcases a traditional cooking style with a focus on aromatic flavors and textures.

name: Chili Con Carne
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add beef and brown.
Add spices, tomato sauce, and beans; simmer 25-30 minutes.
image_description: Chili con carne in a pan, garnished with green onions and basil, surrounded by ingredients including kidney beans, spices, tomato sauce, onion, garlic, and chili peppers, on a wooden surface.

name: Persian Jeweled Rice
directions: Cook rice; mix with saffron and jeweled mix of nuts and dried fruits.
Fluff and serve.
image_description: Persian Jeweled Rice, garnished with almonds, dried fruits, and berries, is presented on an ornate gold-rimmed plate. The dish features a mix of white and yellow rice topped with various ingredients, including raisins, cranberries, and nuts, creating a vibrant and textured appearance.

name: Moroccan Lentil Soup (Harira)
directions: Sauté onions, garlic; add tomato paste and spices.
Add lentils and chickpeas with water; simmer until tender.
Finish with lemon juice and herbs.
image_description: Moroccan Lentil Soup (Harira) in a black pot, featuring chickpeas, tomatoes, onions, and herbs in a reddish-brown broth. The dish is surrounded by various ingredients and spices, presented on a brown surface with a visually appealing arrangement, showcasing a mix of vibrant colors and textures.

name: Thai Red Curry with Chicken
directions: Sauté curry paste in oil; add chicken to sear.
Pour in coconut milk; add vegetables and simmer until cooked.
Finish with basil and fish sauce.
image_description: Thai Red Curry with Chicken in a ceramic bowl, featuring chicken, red and green peppers, cashews, and basil leaves in a red curry sauce, served on a wooden plate with a side of spices and fresh basil.

name: Pasta Arrabbiata
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic and chili in olive oil; add tomato sauce.
Toss with pasta and garnish with parsley.
image_description: Penne pasta in a spicy tomato sauce, topped with halved cherry tomatoes, parsley, and red chili peppers, served in a brown ceramic bowl on a wooden table with a gray cloth napkin and a fork.

name: Cranberry Walnut Salad
directions: Toss greens with cranberries, walnuts, and cheese.
Drizzle with vinaigrette.
image_description: Mixed greens salad with feta cheese, walnuts, and cranberries, topped with a balsamic glaze and served in a ceramic bowl, accompanied by a side of dressing and garnished with additional cranberries and walnuts.

name: Corn Chowder
directions: Sauté onion in butter; add potatoes and corn.
Add milk and simmer until thickened; season.
image_description: A bowl of corn chowder with visible corn kernels and chopped scallions, presented in a creamy yellow broth, surrounded by ingredients including corn on the cob, potatoes, onion, salt, and a spoon, with a warm and inviting color scheme.

name: Eggplant Yakitori Skewers
ingredients: Soy glaze: soy sauce, sugar, mirin
directions: Skewer eggplant chunks; brush with glaze.
Grill until tender; garnish with sesame seeds.
image_description: Grilled eggplant skewers glazed with a dark sauce and sprinkled with sesame seeds, served on a plate with chopsticks nearby.

name: Chana Masala
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas; simmer 15-20 minutes.
image_description: Chana Masala is presented in a large bowl, surrounded by various ingredients. The dish contains chickpeas, tomatoes, onions, and herbs in a reddish-brown sauce. The bowl is centered, with visible ingredients including chickpeas, diced tomatoes, sliced tomatoes, onions, and herbs. The presentation is garnished with spices and herbs on top. The color palette includes shades of brown, red, and green, with a mix of textures from the chickpeas, sauce, and raw ingredients.

name: Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients; whisk in wet ingredients until smooth.
Cook on a hot skillet until bubbles form; flip and cook through.
image_description: Golden-brown pancakes with eggs on top, served in a skillet with syrup and surrounded by ingredients like eggs, salt, and sugar.

name: Mango Lassi
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Chill and serve.
image_description: Mango lassi in a glass, surrounded by ingredients including diced mango, whole mango, sugar, cardamom pods, and a clay pot, presented on a wooden surface with a rustic burlap cloth, featuring a creamy white and yellow beverage with a sprinkle of spice on top.

name: Pesto Pasta with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
directions: Cook pasta; drain.
Toss with pesto and sun-dried tomatoes; top with parmesan.
image_description: Pesto pasta with sun-dried tomatoes, served on a white plate and garnished with grated cheese. The dish is surrounded by ingredients like cheese, tomatoes, and spices, showcasing a mix of green, red, and beige colors. The pasta appears to be cooked al dente, with a vibrant pesto sauce and visible sun-dried tomatoes.

name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
directions: Form patties and brown in a pan; set aside.
Make gravy with mushrooms, onion, flour, and broth; return patties to pan and simmer.
image_description: "Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy, served with rice and onions, garnished with herbs, presented in a brown bowl with a dark background."

name: Simple Garlic Herb Salmon
directions: Season salmon; sear in a pan with garlic and herbs.
Finish with lemon juice and serve.
image_description: "Pan-seared salmon fillets garnished with garlic, herbs, and spices, served in a skillet with lemon and fresh dill."

name: Gnocchi with Sage Butter
directions: Cook gnocchi until floating.
Brown butter with sage; toss with gnocchi and parmesan.
image_description: Pan-seared gnocchi with sage leaves and grated Parmesan cheese, served in a shallow ceramic bowl with a golden fork and spoon on the side, surrounded by ingredients including Parmesan cheese, olive oil, and additional sage leaves, on a beige surface.

name: Shredded Beef Tostadas
directions: Slow-cook beef with spices until tender; shred.
Top tostadas with beef and toppings.
image_description: "Shredded Beef Tostadas on a black plate, garnished with sour cream, pico de gallo, and cilantro, surrounded by lime wedges, on a rustic wooden table with various toppings and spices."

name: Chili Lime Grilled Corn
directions: Grill corn until charred; brush with butter.
Sprinkle chili powder and drizzle lime juice; season.
image_description: "Grilled corn on the cob with charred grill marks, topped with sliced limes, minced garlic, chili peppers, and a reddish-orange spice, served on a black slate plate with scattered lime wedges, chili peppers, and seasoning."

name: Herbed Rice with Peas
directions: Cook rice with peas; stir in greens and butter.
image_description: Herbed rice with peas served in a bowl, surrounded by ingredients including green peas, onions, spinach, and herbs, with a mix of cooked white rice and green peas, garnished with herbs, presented in a casual, earthy-toned bowl.

name: Gulai Ayam (Indonesian Curry Chicken)
directions: Sauté curry paste; add chicken and coconut milk.
Simmer with vegetables until cooked.
image_description: "Gulai Ayam, a curry chicken dish, is presented in a black-rimmed pan with gold handles, filled with chicken, carrots, potatoes, green beans, and peas in a yellow-orange curry sauce, garnished with green herbs, and served on a round wooden platter on a dark wooden table."

name: Spicy Peanut Noodles
directions: Cook noodles; whisk sauce with peanut butter.
Toss noodles with sauce and sesame seeds.
image_description: "Spicy Peanut Noodles in a blue-rimmed bowl, topped with peanuts, sesame seeds, sliced chilies, green onions, and seaweed. The dish is surrounded by various ingredients, including salt, soy sauce, brown sugar mixture, lime, garlic, mint, and whole chilies, arranged on a light gray surface."

name: Herbed Quiche
directions: Whisk eggs with cream and herbs.
Fill crust with cheese and vegetables; pour mixture and bake until set.
image_description: "Herbed quiche cut into eight slices, featuring a golden-brown crust and a filling with visible eggs, herbs, and cheese, surrounded by ingredients like cheese, eggs, and herbs, with a rustic presentation."

name: Baked Ziti
directions: Cook pasta; mix with sauce and meat.
Top with cheese and bake until bubbly.
image_description: "Baked ziti with rigatoni pasta, red sauce, and melted white cheese, topped with browned ground meat, served in a white ceramic dish with tomatoes and a side of red sauce."

name: Herbed Shrimp and Grits
directions: Prepare grits as per package instructions with butter.
Sauté shrimp with garlic; stir in lemon and parsley.
Serve shrimp over grits.
image_description: Herbed shrimp served on a bed of creamy grits, garnished with parsley and garlic, in a savory sauce.

name: Duck Confit (Simple Version)
ingredients: Duck legs confit (or duck legs and fat)
directions: Crisp duck skin in a hot skillet; finish in oven until skin is golden and meat is tender.
image_description: Two duck legs in a shallow pan with garlic cloves and herbs, surrounded by seasonings and condiments, presented on a wooden board with a fork.

name: Lemon Olive Oil Cake
directions: Mix ingredients; bake in loaf pan until a toothpick comes out clean.
image_description: "Lemon Olive Oil Cake: A moist, yellow cake with a golden-brown crust, sliced and presented with visible ingredients including lemons, olive oil, eggs, and sugar, showcasing a baked preparation style with a smooth texture and vibrant yellow color."

name: Salsa Verde Chicken Tajine
directions: Combine ingredients in a tajine or pot; simmer until chicken is cooked and flavors meld.
image_description: "Salsa Verde Chicken Tajine: a hearty stew featuring chicken, potatoes, chickpeas, carrots, onions, green and black olives, and red peppers, garnished with parsley, served in a traditional clay pot with handles, showcasing a rich, savory broth and a medley of colors and textures."

name: Coconut Lime Chicken
directions: Sauté garlic and curry paste; add chicken and coconut milk.
Simmer until chicken is cooked; finish with lime juice.
image_description: "Coconut Lime Chicken curry served in a gray bowl with chicken pieces, sliced red chilies, garlic cloves, lime slices, and cilantro, in a yellow sauce, garnished with additional cilantro and spices, on a dark blue surface."

name: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cook filling with spinach and feta; stuff peppers.
Bake in sauce until peppers tender.
image_description: "Baked green and yellow bell peppers filled with rice, spinach, and feta cheese, garnished with basil leaves, and served in a cast-iron skillet with a red sauce."

name: Gado-Gado (Indonesian Peanut Salad)
ingredients: Peanut sauce: peanuts, palm sugar, tamarind, lime
directions: Arrange vegetables, eggs, and tofu on a plate.
Drizzle with warm peanut sauce and serve.
image_description: Gado-Gado salad presented on a blue ceramic plate, featuring a mix of boiled egg, tofu, chickpeas, peanuts, bean sprouts, shredded carrots, green beans, cabbage, and sliced red bell pepper, topped with a creamy peanut sauce, arranged artfully with varied textures and colors.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water
directions: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken until cooked through; remove and set aside.
In the same wok, sauté garlic, ginger, and dried chilies until fragrant.
Return chicken to the wok, add the peanuts and the sauce mixture.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
image_description: Kung Pao chicken in a wok, surrounded by ingredients, featuring diced chicken, red chilies, and peanuts in a savory sauce, stir-fried and presented in a dark wok with a mix of red, brown, and orange hues.

name: Mapo Tofu
directions: Brown the ground meat in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the spicy bean paste and peppercorns, stirring until fragrant and the oil turns red.
Pour in the chicken broth and soy sauce; bring to a simmer.
Gently add the tofu cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce.
Garnish with green onions and serve.
image_description: Mapo tofu in a wok, featuring tofu cubes, ground meat, and green onions in a savory sauce, garnished with chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns, presented with a wooden spoon.

name: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 300g flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
directions: Toss beef slices with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce; let sit for 10 minutes.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok and sear beef at high heat until browned; remove.
Stir-fry ginger for 30 seconds, then add broccoli, oyster sauce, and soy sauce.
Return beef to the wok and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.
image_description: Beef and broccoli stir-fry with sliced beef, broccoli, and cashews, cooked in a wok and presented on a wooden platter with various seasonings and sauces.

name: General Tso's Chicken
ingredients: 500g chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Coat chicken pieces thoroughly in cornstarch.
Deep fry chicken in hot oil until crispy and golden; drain on paper towels.
In a separate pan, sauté ginger, garlic, and chilies.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; simmer until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the crispy chicken into the sauce until fully coated.
Serve over white rice.
image_description: General Tso's Chicken with white rice, served in a brown ceramic bowl. The dish features crispy fried chicken pieces coated in a dark orange-brown sauce, garnished with sliced red chilies, ginger, and sesame seeds. The meal is presented on a textured gray surface with chopsticks and surrounding ingredients.

name: Pork Potstickers (Dumplings)
directions: Mix pork, cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl.
Place a teaspoon of filling in the center of a wrapper, moisten edges, and fold/pleat to seal.
Heat oil in a flat skillet and arrange dumplings in a single layer.
Fry for 2 minutes until bottoms are golden.
Pour in water and immediately cover with a lid to steam for 5-7 minutes.
Remove lid and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again.
image_description: Pan-seared dumplings garnished with sesame seeds and served with a dipping sauce in a cast-iron pan on a wooden board.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
directions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add tofu, bamboo shoots, soy sauce, and white pepper.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and simmer until thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the beaten egg while stirring gently to create ribbons.
Stir in the rice vinegar at the very end to preserve the 'sour' punch.
Garnish with green onions.
image_description: Hot and Sour Soup served in a black pot with visible ingredients including tofu, bamboo shoots, noodles, and green onions, garnished with a raw egg. The soup has a light brown broth and is surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings.

name: Chow Mein
directions: Boil noodles according to package instructions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry cabbage and carrots for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the wok.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, then pour over the noodles.
Toss at high heat for 2-3 minutes until noodles are slightly charred and well coated.
Serve hot.
image_description: A plate of Chow Mein featuring stir-fried noodles, mixed vegetables including carrots, broccoli, cabbage, and bell peppers, served with chopsticks and accompanied by soy sauce and a seasoning in small bowls.

name: Wonton Soup
directions: Bring chicken broth and soy sauce to a boil in a pot.
Add the wontons and simmer for 5 minutes (or until they float).
Add bok choy and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Turn off heat and stir in sesame oil.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions.
image_description: Three bowls of wonton soup with dumplings and green onions, served on a wooden tray with various seasonings and condiments, including soy sauce, sesame oil, and chopped scallions.

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp
directions: Dip shrimp in egg, then coat with cornstarch.
Fry shrimp in hot oil until golden and crispy; drain.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, honey, and condensed milk.
Toss the warm shrimp and candied walnuts into the sauce until evenly coated.
Serve immediately, usually garnished with steamed broccoli.
image_description: "Shrimp, broccoli florets, walnuts, and quail eggs are presented in a shallow blue bowl. The shrimp are glazed with a brown sauce and topped with a creamy sauce. The dish is garnished with additional walnuts and quail eggs, and is presented on a light blue surface."
